ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Fibers, Soft Sculpture, and Wearable Art. This course will explore fiber-based making through materials, processes, historical context and contemporary practices. Students will be introduced to fabriculture through felt, crochet, embroidery, textile design and sewn soft-sculpture. Process-based skill building will be paired with research and self-initiated studio projects. The course will culminate in an exhibition of work made during the class.
